deed: יורם פלטי מהטכניון פיתח את נובוקיור — שדות חשמליים שמאטים גידולי מוח, באישור ה-FDA
title: Prof. Yoram Palti of the Technion developed electric fields against brain tumors in a basement in Haifa, and the FDA approved

trailer.text: Prof. Yoram Palti, a physician born in Haifa and a professor of physiology and biophysics at the Technion, is the Israeli scientist who, according to ynet, turned electricity into a new weapon against cancer.
According to Novocure, he set up a laboratory in the basement of his home in Haifa, and in 2000 he discovered the effects of Tumor Treating Fields (TTFields) on cancer cells.
According to Nature, that same year he founded Novocure, which developed a portable device that delivers electric fields through patches on the skin.
The FDA approved the treatment for glioblastoma, a brain cancer that is nearly always fatal, in 2011 for patients whose tumor had recurred, and in 2015 for newly diagnosed patients.

glance.label: Where
glance.value: Haifa: a basement laboratory, and today the development center

stations.title: A tumor with almost no treatment

paragraphs.text: According to MIT Technology Review, glioblastoma is a brain cancer that is fast-growing, difficult to treat, and nearly always fatal.
According to an article in JAMA, this is the most common and most aggressive primary brain tumor, and each year it is diagnosed in 3.19 out of every 100 thousand people.
According to the same article, only about a quarter of patients are alive two years after diagnosis, and only 5% to 10% after five years.
According to MIT Technology Review, even with aggressive treatment, median survival is less than two years.
According to a 2011 Novocure announcement, median survival from diagnosis is 15 months with the best treatment.
According to the same announcement, when the tumor recurs only three to four months remain, without additional effective treatment.
Globes wrote in 2016 that two of the first ten participants in Novocure's trial, conducted eight years earlier, were still alive, while the average life expectancy for the disease was six months.
According to JAMA, the standard treatment is surgery, radiation with a drug called temozolomide, and then more temozolomide.
According to JAMA, there has been little progress since this treatment was established.
William Doyle, chairman of Novocure, told IEEE Spectrum that the last advance in treating brain tumors had come about 15 years earlier, when temozolomide was introduced.

stations.title: A physician from Haifa and a basement laboratory

paragraphs.text: According to ynet, Yoram Palti was born in Haifa.
According to ynet, he studied medicine at the Hebrew University and Hadassah, and earned both an MD and a PhD.
According to ynet, in 1971 he was invited to help establish the Technion's faculty of medicine.
According to Mako, he was a professor of physiology and biophysics there.
According to Novocure, Palti unearthed the doctoral thesis he had written about 40 years earlier, on the distribution of electric fields in nerve fibers, and sought to apply it to cancer.
According to the company, he set up a laboratory in the basement of his home in Haifa.
According to the company's history, in 2000 he discovered the effects of the fields on cancer cells.
Globes wrote that he came up with the idea during his retirement.
Mako wrote that he developed the device after he retired.
According to Nature, on the basis of the idea and preliminary in vitro experiments, Palti founded Novocure in 2000.
According to Globes, the first investment, $300 thousand, came from a friend: Lennart Perlhagen, formerly a senior executive at the European pharmaceutical companies Pharmitalia and Meda.
Palti told Globes that there were months when he paid salaries out of his own pocket, while he was on a Technion pension.
According to JAMA, the treatment is called TTFields: low-intensity alternating electric fields that interfere with the division of glioblastoma cells.
According to IEEE Spectrum, at one moment in division the cell distorts into an hourglass shape, and then the field concentrates at its center.
According to IEEE Spectrum, the device, Optune, uses a frequency of 200 kilohertz.
William Doyle, chairman of Novocure, told IEEE Spectrum that this frequency penetrates glioblastoma cells, but not neurons and other normal brain cells.
According to Nature, it is a portable device that does not penetrate the body.
According to Nature, it delivers continuous electric fields through patches placed on the skin in the region of the tumor.
According to IEEE Spectrum, the patient wears four electrode patches on the head and carries the generator in a shoulder bag.
According to JAMA, all treatment was given at home and on an outpatient basis.
Palti said that people did not believe him that the method works.
According to him, there were many charlatans who claimed to cure diseases with electric fields, and the medical journals did not want to publish his work.
Novocure CEO Asaf Danziger said that in meetings people told Palti to his face that he did not understand the field and that it was a big craziness.
According to Danziger, at Memorial Sloan Kettering hospital they were told that glioblastoma is the worst tumor and that they must not treat it.
According to Novocure, the company's first clinical trial began in 2003, with four patients in Switzerland.
According to Novocure, in 2007 the company received CE marking to market the treatment in the European Union, for newly diagnosed and recurrent glioblastoma.
According to Globes, in 2009 the venture capital arms of Pfizer and Johnson & Johnson invested in it for the first time.
According to Mako, in Israel Prof. Zvika Ram, head of the neurosurgery division at Ichilov, was the first to enroll his patients in a clinical trial of the device.
According to Novocure and according to JAMA, 237 patients whose glioblastoma had recurred took part in a randomized trial.
According to the Novocure announcement, patients treated with NovoTTF reached a median survival similar to that of chemotherapy.
According to the announcement, they had fewer side effects and better quality of life scores.
According to JAMA, no survival difference was observed.
According to Novocure, after six months 21% of NovoTTF patients were without disease progression, compared with 15% on chemotherapy.
According to the FDA, an application for approval of the NovoTTF-100A System was filed on August 16, 2010.
In a letter dated April 8, 2011, the FDA informed the company that the application was approved.
On April 14, 2011, Novocure announced the approval.
According to the FDA, the device is intended for patients aged 22 and older with glioblastoma that recurred after chemotherapy.
According to Novocure, this was its first commercial approval in the US for treating cancer.
According to Globes, at first the FDA allowed the product to be sold only cautiously, to patients who had exhausted the other treatment options.
As a condition of approval, the FDA required a follow-up study of 486 subjects, 243 in each group.
The study was intended to test whether survival with NovoTTF is not inferior to chemotherapy, the best standard treatment.

According to JAMA, the EF-14 trial, a separate randomized phase 3 trial that began as early as 2009 in patients newly diagnosed with glioblastoma, compared temozolomide alone with temozolomide together with TTFields.
According to JAMA, 695 patients took part at 83 sites in North America, Europe, South Korea and Israel.
According to JAMA, in the randomization 466 received the combination and 229 received temozolomide alone.
According to Novocure, in 2014 the independent data committee recommended stopping the trial because of early success in the interim analysis.
According to JAMA, after the analysis was published, 26 patients from the control group (11%) crossed over to receive TTFields.
According to JAMA, the study continued to count them in the control group.
According to JAMA, median overall survival was 20.9 months with the fields, compared with 16.0 months without them.
According to JAMA, the median time to disease progression was 6.7 months, compared with 4.0 months.
According to JAMA, with the fields 43% were alive after two years, 26% after three years and 13% after five years.
According to JAMA, with temozolomide alone the figures were 31%, 16% and 5%.
According to JAMA, adding the fields did not significantly increase systemic side effects: 48% vs 44%.
According to JAMA, mild to moderate skin irritation was seen in 52% of patients treated with the fields, and severe irritation in 2%.
According to Novocure, in 2015 the FDA also approved the treatment for newly diagnosed glioblastoma.
Danziger told Nature that Optune with temozolomide is the first treatment in more than a decade to significantly improve outcomes in newly diagnosed glioblastoma.

stations.title: A company from Haifa, the Israel Prize and the people who are connected

paragraphs.text: According to Novocure, in 2015 the company went public on the NASDAQ.
According to Mako (2021), Novocure employs 1,200 people worldwide.
According to Mako, the development center remained in Haifa, and all production is done at the A.L. Electronics plant in Yehud.
According to the same report, 3,600 cancer patients worldwide are connected to the device.
According to ynet, in the PANOVA-3 trial of 571 patients with locally advanced pancreatic cancer, adding Optune Pax to chemotherapy increased median survival from 14.2 to 16.2 months.
According to Mako, about two years before the report a tumor was discovered in Eddie Peleg's brain.
According to Mako, he underwent surgery, radiation and chemotherapy, and then received a recommendation for the electrical treatment.
According to IEEE Spectrum, Jessica Morris, a glioblastoma patient, goes about with a shaved head covered in electrodes.
According to IEEE Spectrum, the electrodes are connected by wires to a large generator that she carries in a shoulder bag.
According to IEEE Spectrum, her MRI scans showed no new tumor growth.
According to Novocure, in 2022 Palti received the Israel Prize for entrepreneurship and technological innovation.
Prof. Zvi Ram said that a small company, originally from Israel, had made the greatest medical revolution in the world in recent years.
Globes wrote in 2016 that it was one of the most significant Israeli contributions to global advances in recent years.
According to the AACR, Palti died on January 11, 2026, at the age of 88, and according to ynet, until his death he was a professor emeritus at the faculty.
According to IEEE Spectrum, the technology has been slow to catch on among doctors.
According to IEEE Spectrum, Prof. Wolfgang Wick of Heidelberg wrote skeptically about the fields.
According to him, doctors do not know which patients will respond best to the fields, and therefore Optune is less appealing as a treatment option.

versions.says: Novocure: Palti discovered the effects of the fields on cancer cells in 2000
Globes: Novocure emerged as an idea in 1992, and was founded in 2000

disagreements.question: How much does the device the patient carries weigh?

IEEE Spectrum: the Optune generator in the shoulder bag weighs 1.2 kg

Nature: the first clinical trials in glioblastoma began in 2009

disagreements.question: What was the tumor response rate in the recurrent glioblastoma trial?

JAMA article: 12% vs 7%

disagreements.question: How many patients were alive after two years in the EF-14 trial?

IEEE Spectrum: 43% of Optune patients, compared with 30% on the standard treatment

disagreements.question: What was the survival rate after four years?

versions.says: IEEE Spectrum: 17% in Optune patients, compared with 10% in the others
The table in the JAMA article: 20% in the fields group, compared with 8% on temozolomide alone

claims.text: לפי ynet, פלטי נולד בחיפה ולמד רפואה באוניברסיטה העברית ובהדסה, והוסמך כרופא וכדוקטור.
claims.quote: Born in Haifa, Palti studied medicine at the Hebrew University of Jerusalem and Hadassah, earning both an MD and a PhD.

claims.text: לפי מאקו/N12 (2021), פלטי היה פרופסור לפיזיולוגיה וביופיזיקה בטכניון, ופיתח את המכשיר החשמלי נגד סרטן אחרי שיצא לגמלאות.
claims.quote: יורם פלטי היה פרופסור לפיזיולוגיה וביופיזיקה בטכניון, אבל את המכשיר החשמלי לריפוי סרטן פיתח כשיצא לגמלאות.

claims.text: ynet הציג את פלטי כמדען ישראלי שהפך חשמל לנשק חדש נגד סרטן.
claims.quote: How an Israeli scientist turned electricity into a new weapon against cancer

claims.text: לפי נובוקיור, פרופ' יורם פלטי הקים מעבדה במרתף ביתו בחיפה, ישראל.
claims.quote: Prof. Yoram Palti sets up a laboratory in his basement in Haifa, Israel.

claims.text: לפי היסטוריית נובוקיור, פרופ' יורם פלטי גילה בשנת 2000 את השפעות שדות הטיפול בגידולים (TTFields) על תאי סרטן.
claims.quote: In the year 2000, he discovered the effects of Tumor Treating Fields (TTFields) on cancer cells.

claims.text: לפי Nature, על בסיס הרעיון וניסויי מבחנה ראשוניים פלטי ייסד את נובוקיור ב-2000.
claims.quote: On the basis of this concept and preliminary in vitro experiments, Palti founded Novocure in 2000.

claims.text: לפי Nature, הטיפול ניתן באמצעות מכשיר נייד לא פולשני שמעביר שדות חשמליים רציפים דרך מערכי מתמרים על העור באזור הגידול.
claims.quote: The therapy is administered via a noninvasive portable device that delivers continuous electric fields to the patient through transducer arrays placed on the skin in the region of the tumor

claims.text: לפי MIT Technology Review, גליובלסטומה היא סרטן מוח קטלני, מהיר גדילה, קשה לטיפול וכמעט תמיד קטלני.
claims.quote: The particularly lethal brain cancer known as glioblastoma multiforme is fast-growing, difficult to treat, and nearly always fatal

claims.text: ב-14 באפריל 2011 הודיעה נובוקיור שה-FDA אישר את מערכת NovoTTF-100A לטיפול בחולים בוגרים עם גליובלסטומה לאחר חזרת הגידול בעקבות כימותרפיה.
claims.quote: Novocure today announced that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approved the NovoTTF-100A System (NovoTTF) for the treatment of adult patients with glioblastoma multiforme (GBM) brain tumors

claims.text: לפי נובוקיור, ב-2015 אישר ה-FDA את הטיפול בגליובלסטומה שאובחנה לאחרונה.
claims.quote: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration approves Tumor Treating Fields therapy for the treatment of newly diagnosed glioblastoma under the Premarket Approval pathway.

claims.text: לפי מאמר JAMA, ניסוי EF-14 גייס 695 חולים ב-83 אתרים בצפון אמריקה, אירופה, דרום קוריאה וישראל.
claims.quote: recruited 695 patients at 83 sites in North America, Europe, the Republic of Korea, and Israel.

claims.text: לפי מאמר JAMA, חציון ההישרדות הכוללת היה 20.9 חודשים עם TTFields וטמוזולומיד לעומת 16.0 חודשים עם טמוזולומיד לבד.
claims.quote: Median overall survival was 20.9 months in the TTFields-temozolomide group vs 16.0 months in the temozolomide-alone group

claims.text: לפי מאקו/N12 (2021), נובוקיור מעסיקה 1,200 עובדים בעולם, מרכז הפיתוח נשאר בחיפה וכל הייצור נעשה במפעל א.ל. אלקטרוניקה ביהוד.
claims.quote: הפיתוח התחיל במרתף של פלטי, והיום נובוקיור מעסיקה 1,200 עובדים בעולם כשמרכז הפיתוח נשאר בחיפה, וכל הייצור נעשה במפעל א.ל.

claims.text: לפי כתבת מאקו/N12 (2021), 3,600 חולי סרטן בעולם מחוברים למכשיר, שלפי הכתבה מגדיל פי 3 את סיכויי ההישרדות.
claims.quote: המראה החייזרי מרתיע בהתחלה, אבל 3,600 חולי סרטן ברחבי העולם מחוברים למכשיר זהה שמגדיל פי 3 את סיכוייהם לשרוד.

claims.text: לפי נובוקיור, ב-2022 קיבל פלטי את פרס ישראל על יזמות וחדשנות טכנולוגית.
claims.quote: Novocure founder Prof. Yoram Palti receives the Israel Prize in recognition of his entrepreneurship and technological innovation.

claims.text: לפי מאמר JAMA, גליובלסטומה היא גידול המוח הראשוני השכיח והאגרסיבי ביותר, בשכיחות שנתית של 3.19 ל-100 אלף.
claims.quote: Glioblastoma is the most common and aggressive primary brain tumor with an annual incidence of 3.19 per 100 000.

claims.text: לפי מאמר JAMA, כרבע מהחולים בלבד בחיים שנתיים לאחר האבחון, ו-5% עד 10% בחיים אחרי חמש שנים.
claims.quote: The disease course is typically rapid, with only approximately 1 in 4 patients alive 2 years after diagnosis, and only 5% to 10% of patients alive at 5 years.

claims.text: לפי MIT Technology Review, גם עם טיפול אגרסיבי חציון ההישרדות של חולי גליובלסטומה קצר משנתיים.
claims.quote: even with aggressive therapy, patients have a median survival time of less than two years.

claims.text: לפי הודעת נובוקיור ב-2011, חציון ההישרדות מהאבחון הוא 15 חודשים בטיפול מיטבי, ומרגע חזרת הגידול רק שלושה עד ארבעה חודשים ללא טיפול יעיל נוסף.
claims.quote: The median overall survival time from initial diagnosis is 15 months with optimal therapy, and median survival from the time of tumor recurrence is only three to four months without additional effective treatment.

claims.text: לפי גלובס (2016), תוחלת החיים הממוצעת במחלה הייתה שישה חודשים.
claims.quote: the average life expectancy for the disease was six months.

claims.text: לפי מאמר JAMA, מאז נקבע הטיפול הסטנדרטי (ניתוח, הקרנות עם טמוזולומיד ואחריהן טמוזולומיד) חל בטיפול במחלה התקדמות מועטה.
claims.quote: little progress has been made in the treatment of this disease.

claims.text: לפי ויליאם דויל, יו"ר נובוקיור, ההתקדמות האחרונה בטיפול בגידולי מוח הייתה כ-15 שנה קודם, עם כניסת הטמוזולומיד.
claims.quote: The last advance in treatment came about 15 years ago when doctors introduced temozolomide.

claims.text: לפי ynet, פלטי הוזמן ב-1971 לסייע בהקמת הפקולטה לרפואה של הטכניון.
claims.quote: he was invited in 1971 to help establish the Technion’s medical school

claims.text: לפי נובוקיור, פלטי שלף את עבודת הדוקטורט שכתב כ-40 שנה קודם, על פיזור שדות חשמליים בסיבי עצב, וביקש ליישם אותה בסרטן.
claims.quote: He unearths his 40-year-old doctoral thesis on the distribution of electric fields in nerve fibers and seeks to apply it to cancer.

claims.text: לפי גלובס (אפריל 2016), פלטי בן ה-78 הגה את הרעיון בתקופת פרישתו.
claims.quote: The person behind the technology at Novocure is 78-year-old Professor Yoram Palti, who came up with the idea during his retirement.

claims.text: לפי גלובס, ההשקעה הראשונה בחברה, 300 אלף דולר, גויסה מחבר, לנארט פרלהאגן, לשעבר בכיר בחברות התרופות האירופיות פרמיטליה ומדה.

claims.quote: Tumor-treating fields (TTFields) is an antimitotic treatment modality that interferes with glioblastoma cell division and organelle assembly by delivering low-intensity alternating electric fields to the tumor.

claims.quote: Optune uses a frequency of 200 kilohertz to get inside glioblastoma cells, but the frequency doesn’t penetrate neurons and other normal brain cells.

claims.quote: Novocure receives the CE certificate to market Tumor Treating Fields therapy for the treatment of newly diagnosed and recurrent glioblastoma in the European Union (2007)

claims.text: לפי גלובס, ב-2009 זרועות ההון סיכון של פייזר וג'ונסון אנד ג'ונסון ביצעו את ההשקעה הראשונה שלהן בנובוקיור.

claims.quote: רם, המשמש כמנהל המערך הנוירוכירורגי בבית החולים, היה הראשון בארץ שהכניס את החולים שלו לניסוי קליני במכשיר

claims.text: לפי הודעת נובוקיור ב-2011, בניסוי פיבוטלי אקראי של 237 חולים חולי NovoTTF השיגו חציון הישרדות דומה לכימותרפיה, פחות תופעות לוואי וציוני איכות חיים טובים יותר.
claims.quote: Results from a 237 patient randomized pivotal trial demonstrated that compared to patients treated with chemotherapy, NovoTTF treated patients achieved comparable median overall survival times, had fewer side effects, and reported improved quality of life scores.

claims.text: לפי מאמר JAMA, בניסוי הפאזה 3 ב-237 חולים עם גליובלסטומה חוזרת לא נצפה הבדל בהישרדות, ושיעור התגובה האובייקטיבית היה 12% לעומת 7%.
claims.quote: Although no survival difference was observed, the higher objective response rate (12% vs 7%) suggested single-modality activity of TTFields.

claims.text: לפי הודעת נובוקיור, שיעור ההישרדות ללא התקדמות לאחר שישה חודשים היה 21% בקבוצת NovoTTF לעומת 15% בחולי הכימותרפיה.
claims.quote: The rate of progression free survival at six months (PFS6) was 21% in the NovoTTF group compared to 15% in chemotherapy patients.

claims.text: לפי מכתב האישור של ה-FDA, בקשת ה-PMA למערכת NovoTTF-100A הוגשה ב-16 באוגוסט 2010.
claims.quote: Re: P100034 NovoTTF- IOA System Filed: August 16, 2010

claims.text: מכתב ה-FDA מ-8 באפריל 2011 הודיע לנובוקיור שבקשת ה-PMA אושרה.
claims.quote: We are pleased to inform you that the PMA is approved.

claims.text: לפי צו האישור של ה-FDA, המכשיר מיועד לחולים בני 22 ומעלה עם גליובלסטומה מאושרת היסטולוגית, לאחר חזרה בעקבות כימותרפיה.
claims.quote: THE DEVICE IS INDICATED FOR TREATMENT OF ADULT PATIENTS (22 YEARS OF AGE OR OLDER) WITH HISTOLOGICALLY- CONFIRMED GLIOBLASTOMA MULTIFORME, FOLLOWING HISTOLOGICALLY- OR RADIOLOGICALLY- CONFIRMED RECURRENCE

claims.text: לפי נובוקיור, ב-2011 אישר ה-FDA את הטיפול בגליובלסטומה חוזרת, האישור המסחרי האמריקאי הראשון של החברה לאינדיקציה בסרטן.
claims.quote: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration approves Tumor Treating Fields therapy for treatment of recurrent glioblastoma under the Premarket Approval pathway.

claims.text: לפי גלובס (2016), בתחילה ה-FDA התיר למכור את המוצר רק בזהירות לחולי גליובלסטומה שמיצו את אפשרויות הטיפול האחרות.
claims.quote: though initially it was only allowed to cautiously sell its product to cancer patients with glioblastoma after they had exhausted all other treatment options.

claims.text: ה-FDA דרש כתנאי לאישור מחקר המשך שבו ייכללו 486 נבדקים, 243 בכל זרוע.
claims.quote: A total of 486 subjects will be enrolled, with 243 subjects per study arm.

claims.text: שאלת מחקר ההמשך שה-FDA דרש היא האם ההישרדות בטיפול ב-NovoTTF אינה נחותה מהטיפול הסטנדרטי הטוב ביותר (כימותרפיה).
claims.quote: Is the overall survival of patients treated with NovoTTF-IOOA non-inferior to the survival of patients treated with the best standard of care (chemotherapy)?

claims.text: לפי מאמר JAMA, ניסוי הפאזה 3 EF-14 החל ב-2009 והשווה טמוזולומיד לבדו לטמוזולומיד בשילוב TTFields בחולי גליובלסטומה.
claims.quote: In 2009, this randomized phase 3 clinical trial was initiated, comparing maintenance temozolomide alone with maintenance temozolomide in combination with TTFields among patients with glioblastoma.

claims.text: לפי מאמר JAMA, החולים חולקו אקראית ביחס 2:1 ל-TTFields עם טמוזולומיד (466) או לטמוזולומיד לבד (229).
claims.quote: Patients were randomized 2:1 to TTFields plus maintenance temozolomide chemotherapy (n = 466) or temozolomide alone (n = 229).

claims.text: לפי נובוקיור, ב-2014 ועדת הנתונים העצמאית של EF-14 המליצה להפסיק את הניסוי בגלל הצלחה מוקדמת בניתוח הביניים.
claims.quote: The EF-14 Independent Data Monitoring Committee recommended stopping the trial because of early success at interim analysis of the data.

claims.text: לפי מאמר JAMA, 26 חולים (11%) מקבוצת הביקורת עברו לקבל TTFields אחרי דצמבר 2014, בעקבות פרסום הניתוח הביניים, והמחקר ניתח אותם בקבוצת הביקורת.
claims.quote: 26 patients (11%) in the temozolomide-alone control group crossed over and received TTFields after December 2014, following release of the results of the interim analysis of the trial.

claims.text: לפי מאמר JAMA, חציון ההישרדות ללא התקדמות היה 6.7 חודשים עם TTFields וטמוזולומיד לעומת 4.0 חודשים עם טמוזולומיד לבד.
claims.quote: Median progression-free survival from randomization was 6.7 months in the TTFields-temozolomide group and 4.0 months in the temozolomide-alone group

claims.text: לפי מאמר JAMA, בקבוצת TTFields עם טמוזולומיד 43% היו בחיים אחרי שנתיים, 26% אחרי שלוש שנים ו-13% אחרי חמש שנים.
claims.quote: the percentage of patients alive at 2 years from randomization was 43% (95% CI, 39%-48%); at 3 years, 26% (95% CI, 22%-31%), and at 5 years, 13% (95% CI, 9%-18%) in the TTFields plus temozolomide group

claims.text: לפי מאמר JAMA, בקבוצת הטמוזולומיד לבד 31% היו בחיים אחרי שנתיים, 16% אחרי שלוש שנים ו-5% אחרי חמש שנים.

quote_translations.c8: Yoram Palti was a professor of physiology and biophysics at the Technion, but he developed the electrical device for curing cancer when he retired.
quote_translations.c76: The development began in Palti's basement, and today Novocure employs 1,200 people worldwide, with the development center remaining in Haifa, and all production is done at the A.L. plant.
quote_translations.c64: The alien appearance is off-putting at first, but 3,600 cancer patients around the world are connected to an identical device that increases their chances of survival 3 times over.
quote_translations.c15: There were many charlatans and impostors who tried, with all sorts of electric fields, to cure all the diseases in the world. The medical journals did not want to publish it
quote_translations.c17: Together we were in meetings where they told him to his face: 'Your glory is already behind you', 'You don't understand anything about this', 'This is really one big craziness'
quote_translations.c16: We talked about glioblastoma (a cancerous tumor in the head) and they said it is the worst tumor, 'You must not treat it, you won't succeed, and even if you succeed you won't prove that it really worked'.
quote_translations.c18: Ram, who serves as head of the neurosurgery division at the hospital, was the first in the country to enroll his patients in a clinical trial of the device
quote_translations.c65: About two years ago a cancerous tumor was discovered in Eddie Peleg's brain; he underwent surgery, radiation and chemotherapy, but cancer of this type tends to recur.
quote_translations.c79: A small company, originally from Israel, has made the greatest medical revolution in the world in recent years, with a technology that did not exist until a few years ago
